research_scope: Emerging AI property products: public first-party evidence

methodology.discovery: Actual web queries followed by opening official pages and launch documentation.
methodology.claim_rule: Capabilities require source IDs. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never NO. Shipped means vendor documents a present capability; no authenticated or transactional feature test performed.
limitations: Current website access alone does not prove functionality or adoption.
Undated live pages establish current documented positioning; launch dates remain UNKNOWN unless explicit.
The seven products include AI products inside larger established platforms, not only newly formed companies.

findings.finding: Seven products have opened first-party evidence; current public documentation is vendor evidence, not hands-on functionality verification.
Flyhomes search should be classified as a transitioned historical product; company remains active, while the original search portal ended July 2, 2025 and assets appear in HeyLeo.

LocalizeOS hunter was investigated but excluded from the main seven because official page extraction failed and current operating status remains UNKNOWN. Indexed descriptions support only provisional lead-nurturing and geographic claims.
Coadjute Clara is AML onboarding assistance; evidence does not establish home-condition risk scoring.
Most distinctive documented evidence: LandTech explicitly live with official-record citations; Orbital linked document-to-map risk; CanaryAI source-document downloads and photo-adjusted valuation.
